title: inga vera subsp. affinis
intro: Inga vera subsp. affinis, commonly known as the Inga tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Fabaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine and is valued for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Inga vera subsp. affinis include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of Inga vera subsp. affinis also exhibit hepatoprotective and antidiabetic activities, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions.
